description: Deterministic Tool Filtering for MCP Servers - Phase 1 & 2 of Three-Brain Architecture
purpose: Strip dangerous, noisy, and low-value tools from MCP servers to reduce context window pressure

servers.aws-lambda: ACTIVE - 17 Lambda functions registered as individual tools

defs_schema_incompatibility.description: @arvoretech/mcp-proxy v1.14.1 cannot register tools from servers whose ListToolsRequest response contains JSON Schema $defs references
defs_schema_incompatibility.workaround: None available in mcp-proxy v1.14.1 (latest). Awaiting upstream fix.

github.description: GitHub MCP Server - Filter dangerous repository operations
github.rationale: Keep only essential PR/issue/branch operations. Remove destructive ops, search noise, and low-value tools.

codemap.description: Codemap MCP Server - Already filtered in mcp_settings.json
codemap.rationale: Session management, backups, macros, routines, templates, labels, scripts, checklists, help already disabled

gitnexus.description: GitNexus MCP Server - No dangerous tools
gitnexus.rationale: All tools are read-only analysis tools. No filtering needed.

qdrant-memory.description: Qdrant Memory MCP Server - No dangerous tools
qdrant-memory.rationale: Only memorize_context and recall_context. Both are safe semantic operations.

aws-ecs.description: AWS ECS MCP Server - Phase 1 Core Observability
aws-ecs.rationale: Read-only ECS cluster, service, and task inspection. No mutation operations exposed.

aws-cloudwatch.description: AWS CloudWatch MCP Server - Phase 1 Core Observability
aws-cloudwatch.rationale: Read-only CloudWatch metrics, logs, and alarms. No mutation operations exposed.

aws-documentation.description: AWS Documentation MCP Server - Phase 1 Core Observability
aws-documentation.rationale: AWS service documentation search and retrieval for troubleshooting guidance.

aws-lambda.description: AWS Lambda Tool MCP Server - Phase 2 Security & Compute (awslabs.lambda-tool-mcp-server)
aws-lambda.rationale: Lambda function management, code deployment, layer management, and permission configuration. Includes both read and write operations for devops-engineer mode.

aws-iam.description: AWS IAM MCP Server - Phase 2 Security & Compute
aws-iam.rationale: Read-only IAM policy analysis, role inspection, and permission simulation for security-review and cloud-architect modes. No mutation operations exposed.

implementation.strategy: Extend mcp_settings.json with expanded disabledTools arrays
implementation.note: Replace $HOME/$APPDATA with your actual home directory. See agent/.env.example for configuration guidance.
steps: 4. Verify no overlap with alwaysAllow list
6. For aws-core: Configure allowlist in mcp_settings.json to expose ONLY listed tools
7. Verify aws-core mutation tools are blocked

expectedOutcome.baseline: This file documents GitHub-server-only filtering plus AWS toolkit allowlist. For full system totals (all 5 MCP servers), see ROO_CODE_CONTEXT.md.
expectedOutcome.toolReduction: GitHub server: ~60 → ~20 tools (67% reduction). AWS toolkit: ~150 → ~20 tools (87% reduction)
expectedOutcome.totalToolCount: GitHub server only: ~72 → ~52 tools (28% reduction). AWS toolkit: ~150 → ~20 tools (87% reduction). Full system: 295 → 107 tools (64% reduction) — see ROO_CODE_CONTEXT.md.
expectedOutcome.safetyLevel: CRITICAL - AWS toolkit mutation operations completely blocked
expectedOutcome.riskLevel: MINIMAL - Only read-only observability and documentation retrieval exposed

checklist: [ ] GitHub MCP server loads without errors
[ ] Dangerous tools (delete_repository, etc.) are not available
[ ] Core tools (list_issues, create_branch, push_files) still work
[ ] AWS toolkit loads with allowlist only
[ ] AWS mutation tools (run_instances, delete_db_instance, etc.) are blocked
[ ] AWS observability tools (describe_*, list_*, get_*) are available
